title: Red cotton stainer bug on cotton

Header: Red cotton stainer bug on cotton
Dysdercus cingulatus Kangambili / sigadulina mbila in Kiswahili

Prevention: Remove cotton plants, all debris and ratoon cotton as soon as harvesting is over by
Keep stores of seed cotton and cotton lint clean to avoid pest multiplying
Cotton should be grown strictly as an annual crop and not as a perennial crop to break the cycle of the pest
Avoid planting cotton near alternative host plants like
Baobab tree (main host of cotton stainer)
Monitoring: Stainer bugs are late season pests.
They appear when the bolls are ripening
An early indication of attack by red cotton stainer is feeding damage on the flower buds and external seed damage
Feeding on bolls causes the boll to abort and shed
When 10 to 20 colonies of cotton stainer are seen on stems or buds per acre, direct control action might be done.
When such colonies are found on bolls, control is too late.
Direct Control: Hand-pick and destroy the bugs in small plots and at the beginning of infestations.
Use 500 grams of fresh custard apple leaf extract, mix with 12-17 litres of water.
Use cooking pot for 2 litres of mixture; boil it until the remaining liquid is about 1 litre.
Strain, then dilute with 10-15 litres of water.
Spray on the infested plants thoroughly.
Use pyrethrum powder to control red cotton stainer.
Mix 20g pyrethrum powder with 10 litres of water, shake well and spray immediately on infested areas during the evening .
Alpha cypermethrin-based products (TataAlpha, Cypercal, SapaCypermethrin, and others); usually applied at 100g/litre but double-check product label. (Pyrethroid group of pesticide).

Spray near to flowering stage and when threshold is reached to kill the young and adult red cotton strainers.
But do not spray during flowering as bees will be killed.

When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval.
Do not empty into drains and water sources.
